description: Rules for rendering and UX behavior of tutorial content in the coaching portal.

rules.title: Click-to-reveal must use details tag
rules.description: Answers and explanations in quizzes or exercise sections must be wrapped in a `<details>` tag with a `<summary>` element. The summary text must start with an icon like '🔑 Click to Reveal Answer & Explanation'. This ensures answers are hidden by default and only shown when the user explicitly clicks.

examples.bad:
🔑 Click to Reveal Answer & Explanation

The correct answer is A because...
examples.good:
<details>
<summary>🔑 Click to Reveal Answer & Explanation</summary>

The correct answer is **A** because...
</details>

rules.title: Tables inside blockquotes must render correctly
rules.description: Markdown tables nested inside blockquotes (e.g. `> | cell |`) must render as actual HTML tables rather than being rendered as raw text with pipe characters. Blockquote indicators `>` must be placed correctly on every line, and the parser/renderer must parse markdown formatting inside the blockquote block.

detection.pattern: Ensures markdown tables inside blockquotes produce HTML <table> instead of raw text

examples.bad:
> 📍 Lesson Roadmap:
> | Section | Audience |
> |:---|:---|
> (Raw text rendering with pipes)
examples.good:
> 📍 Lesson Roadmap:
> 
> | Section | Audience |
> |:---|:---|
> | 1. Tokens | 🟢 Everyone |
